request.text: What is the resistance on ZM1?

solution.item: *** Solution by TINA assisted by AI ***
We know that generator frequency is f=100k Hz, w=2*pi*f
L1 and R1 connected in series so Zb=j*w*L1+R1=628 / 90° Ohm+100 / 0° Ohm=636 / 81° Ohm
C1 and Zb connected in series so Za=1/(j*w*C1)+Zb=1.59k / -90° Ohm+636 / 81° Ohm=968 / -84.1° Ohm
The ohm meter shows Za = 968 / -84.1° Ohm
